There are gundarks nesting in the cave walls."<br />"I saw them on my way down."<br />"You planned the journey back as you came down."<br />"Yes.|Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and his 16-year-old Padawan Anakin Skywalker in the midst of a Tomo Craters gundark nest|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Moment of Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: The Moment of Truth]]''</ref>}}
The '''Tomo Craters''' were located on the planet [[Vanqor]] in the [[Uziel system]].

Formed by an ancient [[Meteorite/Legends|meteor]] shower—thousands of years in Vanqor's past—the Tomo Craters were part of the world's vast areas of rugged terrain that included also deserts and high plateaus.

In this dry, remote section of the planet marked by deep craters and fissures, the planet's expansionist government, under the rule of [[Van-Ith]], created a [[Prison/Legends|detention facility]]—"[[Tomo Camp|The Tomo Camp]]"—which retained prisoners from other worlds in the Uziel system, planets that had been invaded and conquered by Vanqor.

In [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], crash-landed on Vanqor with a crew of [[TY44]] surveillance outpost workers—resistance fighters from the neighboring planet of [[Typha-Dor]] whom they'd come from the galactic [[Core Worlds|Core]] to rescue. Kenobi infiltrated the Tomo Craters, and its infamous camp, to rescue his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and resistance-fighter comrades. Unfortunately also, however, in the midst of their escape, the two Jedi were forced by enemy fire down into the dark depths of the Tomo Craters themselves—into the foul nesting places of the savage beasts called [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]]—out of which they had to fight their way.

By [[Mission to Typha-Dor|mission's]] end, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] duo assisted Typha-Dor to fend off Vanqor's attempts to invade their planet, and to help mediate a peace between the two worlds.
